description: This file defines the DragManager class responsible for handling drag-and-drop interactions within a Chromium-based browser context in Playwright. It manages drag state, intercepts drag events, and communicates with the browser via protocol commands.

classes.name: DragManager
classes.description: Manages drag-and-drop operations, including initiating, canceling, and dropping drags, as well as intercepting drag events caused by move actions.

methods.name: cancelDrag
methods.description: Cancels the current drag operation if one is active by sending a drag cancel event to the browser.

methods.name: interceptDragCausedByMove
methods.description: Handles drag interception caused by move events, setting up event listeners, and managing drag state based on user interactions.

methods.name: isDragging
methods.description: Returns whether a drag operation is currently active.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Completes the drag operation by dispatching a drop event at the specified coordinates.
